from pathlib import Path
import json,csv,hashlib,datetime
R=Path('/Users/aaravsinha/predictive-grid-cells-rl');B=R/'results/native_turn_geometry_resolution';O=B/'original_recovery_supplement'
read=lambda p:json.loads(p.read_text());sha=lambda p:hashlib.sha256(p.read_bytes()).hexdigest()
s=read(O/'summary.json');source=read(B/'pgc33/original/summary.json');rows=list(csv.DictReader((O/'all_directions.csv').open()));keys=('context','prefix','kind','branch','regime','window_updates','evolution_updates','observable','centered','metric')
assert len(rows)==336
lookup={tuple(str(r[k])for k in keys):r for r in source['rows'] if r['normal_test_run']};assert len(lookup)==8
maxerr=0.;seen=set()
for row in rows:
 key=tuple(row[k]for k in keys);r=lookup[key];rec=r['recovery'][row['density']];follow=rec['bounded_followups'];q=follow[-1]['result']if follow else rec['nominal'];d=next(x for x in q['directions'] if x['name']==row['direction']);stats=q['tangent_total_gain']if row['direction']=='tangent'else d['normal_gain'];uid=key+(row['density'],row['direction']);assert uid not in seen;seen.add(uid)
 for a,b in [('gain_median','median'),('gain_p10','p10'),('gain_p90','p90')]:maxerr=max(maxerr,abs(float(row[a])-stats[b]));assert float(row[a])==stats[b]
 assert float(row['normal_informative_fraction'])==d['normal_informative_fraction']
 assert float(row['informative_pair_fraction'])==d['informative_pair_fraction']
 assert int(row['leakage_count'])==d['factor_leakage_count']==0
 assert row['method']==(follow[-1]['method']if follow else'nominal')
 if row['direction']!='tangent':assert float(row['normal_over_tangent_median'])==d['normal_over_tangent_gain']['median'] and row['direction_passes']==str(d['passes'])
 assert q['physical_conclusive'] and q['physical_status']=='failed_recovery' and q['hidden_bound_excess_count']==0
for p,h in s['inputs'].items():assert sha(R/p)==h
assert sha(R/'scripts/report_native_turn_original_recovery.py')==s['source_sha256']
changes=[]
for r in rows:
 if r['density']=='1024':
  a=next(x for x in rows if x['density']=='512' and all(x[k]==r[k] for k in (*keys,'direction')));changes.append(abs(float(r['gain_median'])-float(a['gain_median'])))
assert max(changes)==s['max_512_1024_change_of_direction_median']
groups={'hidden_only':['hidden_only'],'cell_only':['cell_only'],'random_full':[f'random_full_{i:02d}'for i in range(16)],'full_radial':['full_radial'],'cell_radial':['cell_radial'],'tangent_total':['tangent']}
for metric,gs in s['median_gain_ranges_1024'].items():
 for group,rng in gs.items():
  v=[float(r['gain_median'])for r in rows if r['metric']==metric and r['density']=='1024' and r['direction']in groups[group]];assert [min(v),max(v)]==rng
p=read(O/'compact_presentation.json');assert p['complete'] and p['plotted_case_direction_medians']==168
for rel,h in p['protected_artifacts_unchanged'].items():assert sha(R/rel)==h
assert sha(R/p['archived_original_readme']['path'])==p['archived_original_readme']['sha256']
assert sha(O/'README.md')==p['revised_readme_sha256']
for name,h in p['outputs'].items():assert sha(O/name)==h
record=dict(complete=True,saved_summary_and_CSV_review_only=True,no_model_or_environment_execution=True,created_utc=datetime.datetime.now(datetime.timezone.utc).isoformat(),procedure_source=Path(__file__).read_text(),procedure_sha256=sha(Path(__file__)),summary_sha256=sha(O/'summary.json'),full_array_validation_sha256=sha(B/'report_original/validation.json'),source_sha256=s['source_sha256'],compact_source_sha256=sha(R/'scripts/plot_native_turn_original_recovery_compact.py'),rows_independently_matched=336,physically_conclusive_probes=16,maximum_numeric_difference=maxerr,all_medians_ranges_and_density_differences_exact=True,figure_visual_review=dict(compact=True,detailed=True,no_clipping=True,all_168_density1024_case_direction_medians_retained=True),scope='One original PGC context after pre-cue reset; actor-output off-curve response, not h/c norm return; no ring qualification.',artifacts={x.name:sha(x)for x in O.iterdir()if x.is_file()and x.name not in ('artifacts.json','independent_review.json')})
(O/'independent_review.json').write_text(json.dumps(record,indent=2)+'\n');(O/'artifacts.json').write_text(json.dumps({x.name:dict(sha256=sha(x),bytes=x.stat().st_size)for x in sorted(O.iterdir())if x.is_file()and x.name!='artifacts.json'},indent=2)+'\n');print('PASS',len(rows),maxerr,sha(O/'independent_review.json'))
